source_text: Hello, I am Nurse Nor. Today is the 4th of October. The patient is called Amina Juma. She is 32 years old. She came with fever and cough for three days. I gave her fever medicine as the doctor instructed. I told her to return after seven days if she is not better. If she gets breathing difficulty, I have referred her to the big hospital.
